description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSqlTimeseriesDao' that manages time series data operations, including cleanup, asynchronous queries, TTL calculations, and data point calculations, within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AbstractSqlTimeseriesDao
classes.description: An abstract DAO class for handling time series data operations, including cleanup, async processing, TTL computation, and data point calculations.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of old timeseries data based on TTL.

methods.name: processFindAllAsync
methods.description: Processes multiple time series queries asynchronously and aggregates results.

methods.name: computeTtl
methods.description: Calculates effective TTL considering system-wide TTL and provided TTL.

methods.name: getDataPointDays
methods.description: Calculates number of days represented by data points, adjusted for TTL.
